cards.name: Power Glove
cards.text: Lifts rocks, revealing enemies in that square, and adds the Lightning Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Tornado Rod
cards.text: Blows away tiles, unlocking a secret reward, and adds the Darkness Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Hammer
cards.text: Hammers down wooden posts, unlocking a secret reward, and adds the Attack boost Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Sand Rod
cards.text: Raises columns from sand piles, unlocking a secret reward, and adds the Fire Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Hookshot
cards.text: Pulls Warrior to a marked target, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Wall Painting
cards.text: Travels through Fissures, allowing passage between Hyrule and Lorule, and adds the Darkness Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Bomb
cards.text: Opens cave entrances in mountain walls and destroys boulders on land, unlocking a secret reward or revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Boomerang
cards.text: Activates Switches, unlocking a secret reward, and adds the Lightning Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Bow
cards.text: Defeats Beamos, unlocking a secret reward, and adds the Light Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Ice Rod
cards.text: Freezes fire statues, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally, and adds the Water Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Baby Maiamai
cards.text: Given to Mother Maiamai, unlocking a secret reward, and adds the Water Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.

cards.name: Fire Rod
cards.text: Melts ice statues, revealing enemies in that square, and adds the Fire Element Nice Power to the Ravio Board.
